    <= (product_j A_j) product_j sinh(x_j).

2 sum_j x_j=log( V_(n-1) V_n / (V_(n+r-1) V_(n+r)) ).

r(k)>=c_h q_k,  A_(n,r)=O_h(q_k),
B_(n,r)=o_h(q_k log k),
